title: Sogetsu BuxMont Study Group
content_html: The Sogetsu BuxMont Study Group is a community of Sogetsu Ikebana teachers and students based in the Greater Philadelphia area, primarily serving members in Bucks County and Montgomery County, Pennsylvania. The group was established in May 2016 by Ms. Meei-huey Lin, a Taiwan native whose passion for Ikebana was inspired by her mother and who has taught Ikebana classes since 2004. The group actively participates in flower arrangement exhibitions across the region, including the Philadelphia Flower Show, local church exhibits, and the Taiwanese-American East Coast Conference. Through these exhibitions, the group showcases the creativity and talents of its members while advancing the art of Ikebana in the Taiwanese American and broader community.
